2607.09336.title: Shortcut Trajectory Planning for Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning
2607.09336.paper_summary: Diffusion-based trajectory planners have shown strong performance in offline reinforcement learning, but their iterative denoising process often incurs high inference cost. Consistency-based planners reduce the number of sampling steps, yet they typically rely on a two-stage teacher--student distillation pipeline that increases training cost and may introduce instability. We propose Shortcut Trajectory Planning (STP), an offline model-based reinforcement learning framework that incorporates shortcut models as efficient trajectory generators. STP trains a conditional shortcut trajectory model in a single stage, supports adjustable one-step and few-step inference through step-size conditioning, and selects candidate plans using a critic augmented with feasibility-aware correction. Across standard D4RL benchmarks, including locomotion, navigation, manipulation, and dexterous control tasks, STP achieves strong performance while simplifying the training pipeline for fast generative planning.
2607.09336.paper_summary_zh: 擴散基礎的軌跡規劃器在離線強化學習中表現出色，但其迭代去噪過程通常會產生高昂的推理成本。基於一致性的規劃器減少了取樣步驟的數量，但它們通常依賴於一個兩階段的教師-學生蒸餾流程，這增加了訓練成本並可能引入不穩定性。我們提出了快捷軌跡規劃（STP），這是一個離線模型基礎的強化學習框架，將快捷模型作為高效的軌跡生成器。STP在單一階段訓練條件快捷軌跡模型，通過步長條件支持可調的一步和少步推理，並使用增強可行性修正的評估器選擇候選計劃。在標準的D4RL基準測試中，包括運動、導航、操作和靈巧控制任務，STP在簡化快速生成規劃的訓練流程的同時實現了強勁的性能。
2607.09336.author: Guanquan Wang et.al.
